title: [Netflix Official License] Shark Smart Projector with Android 13 | 4K HDR Support, 18000 lm Brightness, Dolby Audio, Auto Image Correction, Built-in Speaker, WiFi & HDMI Connectivity
bullets: Smart Android 13 Entertainment Hub- Enjoy seamless streaming with Android 13 smart OS and access to popular OTT apps. This smart projector delivers a TV-like experience with smooth navigation, wireless connectivity, and hassle-free entertainment for movies, series, sports, and kids' content.

Auto Focus & Intelligent Keystone Correction- Advanced auto image correction technology automatically adjusts focus and screen alignment for a perfectly balanced display. Enjoy a clear picture without manual adjustments, even when projector placement changes.

Dolby Audio & 300-Inch Cinematic Display- Built-in Hi-Fi stereo speaker with Dolby Audio delivers immersive sound and crystal-clear dialogue. Project content on screens up to 300 inches for a true cinema-like viewing experience in your home, office, or outdoor space.

WiFi 6, Bluetooth & HDMI ARC Connectivity- Connect smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, TV sticks, soundbars, and streaming devices through WiFi, Bluetooth, HDMI ARC, and USB ports. Supports wireless screen mirroring for Android and iOS devices with stable, lag-free streaming.

Flexible Projection for Bedroom & Ceiling Viewing- Designed with a rotatable stand for wall, table, and ceiling projection. Watch movies comfortably while lying down, making it ideal for bedrooms, apartments, dorm rooms, and compact entertainment spaces.

Portable Smart Projector with 2-Year Warranty- Compact and easy to carry for home entertainment, travel, gaming, educational use, and presentations. Includes 2-year manufacturer warranty (registration required) for added peace of mind.
